tasks.title: Add Result/Error, the ProblemDetails mapping and the client-header filter to Common
tasks.dod: Unit tests for `Error` → ProblemDetails mapping pass (status, `errorCode`, field-keyed `errors`); Integration test: unsafe `/api` request without `X-Rochambeau-Client` → `400 common.client_header_required`; `GET /health` still `200`; `Common/` references no Identity or module type.

tasks.title: Encode the Identity domain rules: username, email, password, role, lockout and cap policy
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover every boundary in the edge table and pass; `Domain/` has no `using` of ASP.NET Core, EF Core or `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity`.

tasks.title: Map the Account entity to identity.accounts and promote the staged migration
tasks.dod: Staged migration promoted to the live `Common/Persistence/Migrations/`; `dotnet ef database update` applies it and `dotnet ef database update 0` reverts it, leaving no `identity` schema; Integration test proves both unique indexes and the CHECK, with the exact constraint names; `AppDbContext` has no reference to `Account`.

tasks.title: Wire Identity core, the cookie session and deny-by-default authorization in IdentityModule
tasks.dod: Integration test: a probe endpoint registered only in the test host (e.g. via `IStartupFilter` in `WithWebHostBuilder`) answers anonymous calls with `401 identity.not_authenticated` and no redirect; Integration test resolves `IOptions<…>` from the host and asserts the cookie (Strict, Secure, HttpOnly, 7 d, sliding), stamp interval (zero), lockout (5 / 15 min) and password (8, no classes) values; Existing `SmokeTests` (`GET /health` → 200) still pass.

tasks.title: Expose ICurrentAccount and IAccountDirectory through Identity Contracts
tasks.dod: Unit tests: principal built by the claims factory → the right `AccountIdentity`; anonymous → "nobody"; Integration test: `IAccountDirectory` finds by id and by Username (case ignored), and returns "not found" for unknown and partial values; QG-4 architecture test passes.

tasks.title: Implement the in-process RegistrationCap sliding window
tasks.dod: Unit tests for every edge case pass, including the 10-way parallel case; No address is logged or persisted; the cap state lives only in memory.

tasks.title: Register an Account through POST /api/v1/accounts
tasks.dod: Integration tests for AC-01, AC-02, AC-03 and AC-14 pass against Testcontainers PostgreSQL; The `201` body has exactly `username`, `email`, `joinedAt`, `role`, and the cookie is set.

tasks.title: Enforce the registration cap and prove the race guard on registration
tasks.dod: AC-03b concurrency tests (username and email) pass on every run: exactly one row, N−1 `409`; AC-15 tests pass with a fake clock, including "failed attempts don't count" and QG-1 (h).

tasks.title: Log in through POST /api/v1/session with lockout and enumeration-safe errors
tasks.dod: Integration tests for AC-04, AC-05, AC-06 pass; the AC-06 test uses the fake `TimeProvider`; Unknown-email and wrong-password responses are byte-identical in status, body and `errorCode`.

tasks.title: Serve GET /api/v1/me and log out with DELETE /api/v1/session
tasks.dod: Integration tests for AC-07, AC-08 (session-lifetime with fake clock), AC-09 and AC-10 pass; The `/me` response has exactly `username`, `email`, `joinedAt`, `role`.

tasks.title: Serve the public Profile through GET /api/v1/profiles/{username}
tasks.dod: Integration tests for AC-10, AC-11 and AC-12 pass; The `200` JSON has exactly `username`, `joinedAt`, `role`.

tasks.title: Add the operator-command hook and the grant-admin / revoke-admin ChangeRole flow
tasks.dod: Integration tests for AC-13, AC-13b (HTTP side) and AC-14 pass; the registry dispatch unit test passes; Running the API executable with `grant-admin <username>` changes the role and exits without serving HTTP (manual check noted in the PR); `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/architecture-map.md` list the `Commands/` layer.

tasks.title: Revalidate the session on every hub invocation with SessionRevalidationHubFilter
tasks.dod: Integration test proves AC-13b over a hub connection: the connection is closed on the first invocation after the role change; The filter is registered globally (no per-hub opt-in).

tasks.title: Measure the spec §6 latency targets for register, log in and view a profile
tasks.dod: Three latency tests pass locally against Testcontainers PostgreSQL, using the spec §6 method exactly.

tasks.title: Add the shared API client and the «me» query to the SPA
tasks.dod: Vitest tests: header always sent; `401` → `null`; ProblemDetails, `errors` and `lockoutEnd` parsed; `npm --prefix web run lint` and `build` clean.

tasks.title: Build the Register screen with field-level errors
tasks.dod: RTL tests for success, field errors (password cleared, other input kept), both conflicts and the cap pass; `npm --prefix web test`, `lint` and `build` clean.

tasks.title: Build the Log-in screen, the log-out action and the logged-in route guard
tasks.dod: RTL tests for login success, `401`, `423`, logout and the guard pass; `npm --prefix web test`, `lint` and `build` clean.

tasks.title: Build the own Profile and public Profile screens
tasks.dod: RTL tests: own profile shows the email + role, public profile shows no email, the `404` message, and the Administrator label; `npm --prefix web test`, `lint` and `build` clean.

tasks.title: Resolve ICurrentAccount from the hub caller inside hub invocations
tasks.dod: Integration test: a test-hub method returning `ICurrentAccount.Current` yields the logged-in Player's id, username and role over **WebSockets and LongPolling**. `SessionRevalidationHubFilter` sets a scoped holder from `HubCallerContext.User` that `CurrentAccount` reads before the accessor. Unit + integration + `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` clean.

tasks.title: Reject hub invocations once the session ticket has expired
tasks.dod: Fake-clock integration test: an invocation 7 days + 1 minute after the last activity is refused as not authenticated; one before expiry still succeeds. Unit + integration + format clean.

tasks.title: Add the mandatory login and registration-cap edge-case tests
tasks.dod: Three integration tests asserting (a), (b), (c). Production code is expected to already satisfy them, so a first-run green is checked by mutation (temporarily breaking the guarded behaviour turns each red). Integration + format clean.

tasks.title: Make the lockout check and failure count atomic under concurrent log-ins
tasks.dod: Integration test firing ~20 wrong passwords in parallel: at most 5 are evaluated as failures before the block (the rest answer 423), and a correct password arriving while locked gets no session. Failure write and success reset are conditional on `lockout_end IS NULL OR lockout_end <= now`; zero rows → 423 from the stored end. Unit + integration + format clean.

tasks.title: Give request-binding failures a ProblemDetails errorCode
tasks.dod: Integration tests: a malformed and an empty body on both endpoints return 400 ProblemDetails carrying a contract-listed `errorCode`. Unit + integration + format clean.

tasks.title: Apply the client-header check to negotiate with a trailing slash
tasks.dod: Integration test: `POST …/negotiate/` without the header is rejected like the slash-less path. Integration + format clean.

tasks.title: Make the module-boundary architecture test see method-body references
tasks.dod: Unit test: an offender that only calls `db.Set<Account>()` inside an async method, and one that only reads a static Identity-internal member in a method body, are both detected; the real assembly still passes. Unit + format clean.

tasks.title: Treat any 401 from an authenticated query as logged out, and keep me fresh briefly
tasks.dod: RTL test: `me` 200 + profile 401 → "Log in or register first." is shown. A 401 from any query clears `me` (global `QueryCache` `onError`). The `me` query has a short `staleTime` so the `setMe` comment holds. `npm --prefix web test`, `lint`, `build` clean.

tasks.title: Keep the Player view and show an error when log-out fails
tasks.dod: RTL tests: DELETE 500 → still the Player view + "Could not log out. Please try again."; 401 → treated as logged out. Web test, lint, build clean.

tasks.title: Offer Register and Log-in links on the landing page
tasks.dod: RTL test: a Visitor sees "Create account" and "Log in" links; a Player sees "My profile". Web test, lint, build clean.

tasks.title: Move focus to the first invalid field after a failed submit
tasks.dod: RTL test: after a 400 with field errors, focus is on the first `aria-invalid="true"` input (Register and Log in). Web test, lint, build clean.
